meta.layers: primitive (neutral-*, blue-*, …) → semantic (background, primary, review-*) → component (button-*, rail-*, bubble-*, gutter-*)

tokens.name: neutral-50
tokens.usage: Apple light gray. Light window ground; dark-mode text.

tokens.name: blue-600
tokens.usage: Apple blue for light surfaces (4.7:1 on white).

tokens.name: yellow-500
tokens.usage: Yellow for the brand star on light grounds.

tokens.name: night-700
tokens.usage: Brand night, top of the app-icon ground.

tokens.name: night-950
tokens.usage: Brand night, bottom of the app-icon ground.

tokens.name: background
tokens.usage: Window ground behind everything (Apple's light gray / true black). Glass panels float over it.

tokens.name: foreground
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on `background`, `card`, `glass` and `popover` (16.9:1 light, 18.6:1 dark).

tokens.name: card
tokens.usage: Solid content surfaces: the editor sheet, onboarding form groups, library book tiles.

tokens.name: popover
tokens.usage: Menus, selects and tooltips: glass at 80% so small text stays crisp.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: The accent: default buttons, the author's chat bubbles, links, selected states. White on it is 4.7:1 (light); 3.7:1 (dark) so dark-mode primary buttons use 15px semibold text.

tokens.name: secondary
tokens.usage: Neutral fill: secondary buttons, the agent's chat bubbles, badges.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Quiet wells: segmented-control track, gutters, hovered rows.

tokens.name: muted-foreground
tokens.usage: Secondary text: descriptions, help, timestamps, placeholder text (4.6:1 on `background`, 4.9:1 on `card`; 7.0:1 dark).

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed fill for ghost/outline buttons and menu items (6% black / 9% white).

tokens.name: destructive
tokens.usage: Delete actions and errors. White on it: 5.6:1 light, 3.3:1 dark (dark uses 15px semibold).

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Hairlines between content: cards, separators, table rules.

tokens.name: input
tokens.usage: Field borders: inputs, textareas, the composer.

tokens.name: ring
tokens.usage: Focus ring (3px at 50%) and the selected chapter's indicator.

tokens.name: sidebar-primary
tokens.usage: Selected item marker in the rail.

tokens.name: glass
tokens.usage: Liquid Glass, regular: 54% white (light) or 45% smoke (dark), over a 22px blur at 190% saturation, with a specular top edge, a shaded lower rim and a soft sheen. Header, tab pill, chapter rail, floating toolbars.

tokens.name: glass-strong
tokens.usage: Liquid Glass, strong: 76% (light) or 72% (dark). For wide panels with a lot of text (agent, review) and dialogs.

tokens.name: glass-edge
tokens.usage: Hairline highlight around glass (kept for the older single-line edge).

tokens.name: glass-outline
tokens.usage: Outer rim of glass: a bright hairline that separates it from what is behind.

tokens.name: wash-top
tokens.usage: Legacy: top of the old flat wash. The ambient tokens replace it.

tokens.name: wash-bottom
tokens.usage: Legacy: bottom of the old flat wash.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Caution: unsaved changes, high context use. Yellow, for dots, rings and fills only, always with a word beside it; never for text. No orange, no brown.

tokens.name: brand-ribbon-1
tokens.usage: Brand ribbon gradient start (at the spine).

tokens.name: glass-specular
tokens.usage: Specular highlight on the lit (top) edge of glass and the sheen across its upper third.

tokens.name: glass-rim-low
tokens.usage: The shaded lower rim of glass: with the specular top it gives the lensed, 3D edge.

tokens.name: glass-secondary-fg
tokens.usage: Secondary text on glass. Light glass over the ambient window needs a darker grey than muted-foreground to keep 4.5:1 (5.1:1 worst case).

tokens.name: glass-accent-fg
tokens.usage: Blue text and links on glass (5.2:1 light, 5.1:1 dark, worst case). Filled buttons keep primary.

tokens.name: success-text
tokens.usage: Success and confirmation text on its own tint (notice strips, saved states, diff additions). 5.3:1 on the 12% tint in light, 8:1 in dark. Icons and fills keep success.

tokens.name: destructive-text
tokens.usage: Error text on its own tint (Application Error card, save alert, failed turn, refused edits). 5.0:1 on the 12% tint in light, 6.3:1 in dark. Icons, borders and fills keep destructive.

tokens.name: glass-tint
tokens.usage: Tint inside selected glass (the segmented thumb, the active chapter) so selection reads as coloured light.

tokens.name: ambient-base
tokens.usage: Window ground under the ambient light. Never shown bare: the four ambient glows sit on it.

tokens.name: ambient-1
tokens.usage: Ambient glow, top-left: a quiet slate blue. Gives glass something to refract without competing with content.

tokens.name: ambient-2
tokens.usage: Ambient glow, top-right: cool grey-lavender, barely tinted.

tokens.name: review-pacing
tokens.usage: Pacing: slow or rushed stretches. Also drives the gutter pacing strip. Stroke colour; underline style `solid`. Never the only cue: each finding also shows its category label and icon.

tokens.name: review-pacing-tint
tokens.usage: Wash behind a hovered or selected pacing finding (12% light, 22% dark).

tokens.name: review-repetition
tokens.usage: Repeated words, phrases and sentence openings. Stroke colour; underline style `double`. Never the only cue: each finding also shows its category label and icon.

tokens.name: review-repetition-tint
tokens.usage: Wash behind a hovered or selected repetition finding (12% light, 22% dark).

tokens.name: review-filler
tokens.usage: Filler words and adverbs (very, just, really, -ly). Stroke colour; underline style `dotted`. Never the only cue: each finding also shows its category label and icon.

tokens.name: review-filler-tint
tokens.usage: Wash behind a hovered or selected filler finding (12% light, 22% dark).

tokens.name: review-passive
tokens.usage: Passive voice. Stroke colour; underline style `dashed`. Never the only cue: each finding also shows its category label and icon.

tokens.name: review-passive-tint
tokens.usage: Wash behind a hovered or selected passive finding (12% light, 22% dark).

tokens.name: review-dialogue
tokens.usage: Dialogue tags and attribution (said-bookisms, adverb tags). Stroke colour; underline style `solid`. Never the only cue: each finding also shows its category label and icon.

tokens.name: review-dialogue-tint
tokens.usage: Wash behind a hovered or selected dialogue finding (12% light, 22% dark).

tokens.name: review-variety
tokens.usage: Sentence length and rhythm: runs of same-length sentences. Stroke colour; underline style `wavy`. Never the only cue: each finding also shows its category label and icon.

tokens.name: review-variety-tint
tokens.usage: Wash behind a hovered or selected variety finding (12% light, 22% dark).

tokens.name: review-telling
tokens.usage: Show vs tell: stated emotions and summaries (agent). Stroke colour; underline style `wavy`. Never the only cue: each finding also shows its category label and icon.

tokens.name: review-telling-tint
tokens.usage: Wash behind a hovered or selected telling finding (12% light, 22% dark).

tokens.name: review-voice
tokens.usage: Character voice drifting from the profile (agent). Stroke colour; underline style `dashed`. Never the only cue: each finding also shows its category label and icon.

tokens.name: review-voice-tint
tokens.usage: Wash behind a hovered or selected voice finding (12% light, 22% dark).

tokens.name: review-continuity
tokens.usage: Continuity conflicts with memories or earlier chapters (agent). Stroke colour; underline style `solid`. Never the only cue: each finding also shows its category label and icon.

tokens.name: review-continuity-tint
tokens.usage: Wash behind a hovered or selected continuity finding (12% light, 22% dark).

tokens.name: button-ghost-hover
tokens.usage: Ghost/outline button hover and pressed fill.

tokens.name: segmented-thumb
tokens.usage: Selected segment: a glass droplet (near-white on light, frosted white on dark) with specular edge.

tokens.name: resize-handle
tokens.usage: Resize grabber while dragging or focused.

families.ui: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "SF Pro Text", "SF Pro Display", system-ui, "Helvetica Neue", "Segoe UI", sans-serif
families.reading: "New York", ui-serif, "Iowan Old Style", Georgia, serif

styles.name: large-title
styles.usage: The one page title per screen (Library).

styles.name: title-2
styles.sample: How to Use AI Book Studio
styles.usage: Section titles, book titles on tiles.

styles.name: headline
styles.usage: Toolbar titles, list row titles, dialog titles.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Everything lives in your browser. Export regularly.
styles.usage: Default UI text, chat messages, field values.

styles.name: callout
styles.usage: Buttons, segmented controls, menu items, form labels.

styles.name: subheadline
styles.sample: The internal name that helps you find this project.

styles.name: caption-2
styles.usage: Token/cost metadata and badges' smallest labels (tabular figures).

styles.name: chapter-title
styles.usage: The chapter title above the manuscript (New York on Apple devices).

styles.name: manuscript
styles.sample: Welcome to AI Book Studio—a free, open-source platform for writing books with AI agents.
styles.usage: The chapter text in the editor and reader.

styles.name: line-number
styles.usage: Editor gutter numbers; same 28px leading as `manuscript` so they never drift.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Between related controls; segmented item padding.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Glass bar inner padding; list row vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gaps between major regions; empty-state padding.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Page top margin above the large title.

radius.note: Concentric: an inner corner = outer corner − padding.

tokens.name: corner-sm
tokens.usage: Menu items, small badges' container, checkboxes (6px).

tokens.name: corner-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, list rows, segmented items.

tokens.name: corner-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, the composer, menus, the segmented track.

tokens.name: corner-xl
tokens.usage: Glass panels: header bar, chapter rail, chat panel.

tokens.name: corner-full
tokens.usage: Pills: the floating tab bar, chips, avatars.

tokens.name: elevation-glass
tokens.usage: Floating glass: a soft, slightly blue-tinted lift in light; deep in dark.

tokens.name: touch-target
tokens.usage: Minimum hit area on touch screens (iOS 44pt). Icon buttons keep their 28–32px look; the hit area grows on coarse pointers.

tokens.name: icon-sm
tokens.usage: Icons in small segmented controls and badges (12–13px).

tokens.name: icon-md
tokens.usage: Icons in buttons, menus and rows.

tokens.name: icon-lg
tokens.usage: Icons in tiles and empty states (20px); 28px for hero tiles.

tokens.name: line-length
tokens.usage: Characters per book line. Matches BOOK_LINE_LENGTH in the agent's line tools; the gutter numbers these lines.

tokens.name: measure
tokens.usage: Manuscript column width that holds a 66-character line at 17px New York (≈580px).

tokens.name: chat-width
tokens.usage: Assistant/Review panel default width (min 320, max 640; 420 in onboarding).

duration.note: Shared motion timings. Reduced Motion sets them to 0.

tokens.name: duration-fast
tokens.usage: Colour, background and opacity changes; hover.

tokens.name: bp-ipad-mini-portrait
tokens.usage: iPad mini portrait: single column; rail and chat become sheets.

tokens.name: bp-lg
tokens.usage: Below this the chapter rail starts collapsed.

tokens.name: bp-ipad-mini-landscape
tokens.usage: iPad mini landscape: rail strip + manuscript + 360px panel.

tokens.name: bp-xl
tokens.usage: Below this the chat/review panel starts collapsed.
